title: Parallax Shore
description: A surreal split-landscape painting showing a desert with terraced hills and a tower on the left, transitioning through a glowing crystalline river into a lush green valley with bridges and forests on the right. The right side features purple mountains, a giant stone head, glowing blue crystals, and multiple moons in a twilight sky.
